color.note: Dark only: Flick is a living-room screen. The chrome is monochrome (black, white, translucent white); colour only ever comes from the artwork, through the ambient backdrop.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The neutral black under everything: the ambient backdrop's base and the window ground when no artwork is selected.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons. 16:1 or better on background, card, glass and glass-strong.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Opaque raised surface (shadcn card). Most surfaces are glass instead.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Opaque-ish menus from shadcn primitives; Flick's own menus use glass-strong.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The primary action fill (Play, Resume, Save) and every focused control: white.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary or on any focused (white) control.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles under card titles, hints, leads, section labels. 6.4:1 on glass, 6.9:1 on background.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative only: separators in the meta line, placeholders. 3.4:1 on background, fails 4.5:1, so never for body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlight fill in shadcn primitives.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Danger button text and destructive actions. 5.8:1 on glass.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border colour; rings around plain pills.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Fallback 2px focus outline for plain elements (offset 2px). Flick components draw focus themselves: white fill + lift.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted surface fill over the blurred artwork: sidebar, tab bar, panels, settings groups, glass buttons, fields. Always with glass-blur and shadow-glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser frosted surface for overlays: dialogs, context menus, the profile popover. With glass-strong-blur and shadow-glass-strong.

tokens.name: glass-opaque
tokens.usage: glass when Frosted panels is off (data-blur=false): no backdrop-filter, more opaque.

tokens.name: glass-strong-opaque
tokens.usage: glass-strong when Frosted panels is off.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on rows and sidebar items (bg-white/[0.07]).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The resting pill under the active tab bar item (white/16). Segments use white/18, sidebar items white/14.

tokens.name: artwork-placeholder
tokens.usage: Behind artwork while it loads, card skeletons, missing posters (title set in white/55 on it).

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Track of the resume bar on cards; the fill is foreground.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, with a small backdrop blur.

tokens.name: ambient-base
tokens.usage: Runtime: the artwork's base colour, luminance-clamped in Rust to 7.5 %. This is its neutral default.

tokens.name: ambient-accent
tokens.usage: Runtime: the artwork's accent light. Neutral default shown.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon (Tailwind amber-200): Notice warn, Pill warn. 13:1 on glass.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error notice icon (Tailwind red-300). Always paired with the alert icon and words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: profile-blue
tokens.usage: Profile colour 1. Tints only that profile's avatar gradient and the picker's ambient light; never chrome.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif
families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero title when the artwork has no logo (Home carousel, detail page). Drop shadow 0 4px 24px black/45.

styles.name: shelf-title
styles.usage: Shelf (row) headings on Home and detail pages.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel headings; profile names under avatars.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Page leads and hero overviews (overview in white/80, max 3 lines).

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Flick Frame tab bar items; lg buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text size across the chrome (15px).

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Settings row labels, sidebar items, menu items, meta line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: md button labels and card titles (leading-tight, truncated).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Card subtitles, row hints, field labels (500), sm buttons (600). In muted-foreground.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Settings group titles: uppercase, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Server badge on a focused card; compact row hints.

spacing.note: Everything is in rem, so Flick Frame scales the whole UI by changing the root font size: 16px on the desktop, clamp(15.3px, 1.0625vw, 34px) in Frame. The -frame and -compact tokens are the overrides under html.frame and [data-density=compact].

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page padding; shelves scroll edge to edge inside it.

tokens.name: page-top-frame
tokens.usage: page-top in Flick Frame (clears the floating tab bar).

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a shelf or grid.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: Width of a 16:9 thumb card (episodes, Continue Watching).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width, and the content's left offset (heroes bleed under it).

tokens.name: sidebar-w-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar: exactly wide enough to centre the icons, which never move.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glass control inner padding (segmented, tab bar track: 0.375rem).

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Settings group and menu inner padding: rows sit concentric inside.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, sidebar padding, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog stack gap; hero stack gap.

radius.note: Radius follows content, and nested shapes are concentric: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius (14px); the scale below multiplies it.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Thumb cards (16:9); rows inside a 2xl group or menu (25.2 - 6 = 19.6px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Settings groups, context menus, text fields, notices.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs; the close button sits centred on the corner's arc.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, segments, switches, avatars, PIN keys: every control is a pill or a disc.

shadow.note: Depth comes from focus (lift + deep shadow) and glass rims, not from routine grey shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The rim of every glass surface: a lit top edge and a faint inner line.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-strong
tokens.usage: glass-strong overlays: rim plus a long drop.

tokens.name: shadow-card-lifted
tokens.usage: Artwork focused or hovered: the deep lift.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Context menu (ItemMenu), on top of glass-strong.

tokens.name: shadow-switch-focus
tokens.usage: A focused standalone switch: dark gap, then a solid white ring.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii. Glass also saturates what is behind it (1.6, strong 1.8).

tokens.name: ambient-blur
tokens.usage: The artwork behind the whole screen (with saturate 1.6, brightness 0.62).

scale.note: The focus lift, per control. Focus is the one spectacular thing in the UI.

tokens.name: lift-card
tokens.usage: A focused media card, profile tile or PIN key.
